component.name: Apache Archiva
component.description: Build artifact repository manager. The project has retired (see its Attic page). The security page documents the security vulnerabilities fixed in released Archiva versions with mitigation guidance; binary patches for individual vulnerabilities are not provided, users must upgrade to a version where the fix is implemented.

externalReferences.comment: Source security page; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Cross-site scripting (stored and reflected)
threats.description: Multiple fixed XSS issues: CVE-2023-28158 (authenticated users crafting malicious directory names via file upload to gain elevated privileges up to administrator), CVE-2019-0213 (malicious XSS stored in the central configuration logo URL, exploitable only by admin-role users or when browser-server communication is compromised), CVE-2013-2187 and CVE-2011-0533 (crafted request parameters injecting arbitrary HTML or JavaScript into the home and user management pages), and CVE-2011-1077 (JavaScript appended in a request parameter or stored as a submitted form value getting executed).

threats.name: Cross-site request forgery against REST endpoints and admin sessions
threats.description: Several REST service endpoints were not protected against CSRF attacks: a malicious site opened in the same browser as the Archiva site could perform arbitrary actions (CVE-2017-5657), attackers could craft hidden image tags to exploit administrator sessions (CVE-2011-1026), and a specially crafted page could force Archiva administrators to change their credentials (CVE-2010-3449).

threats.name: LDAP injection via the login form
threats.description: By providing special values to the Archiva login form an attacker is able to retrieve user attribute data from the connected LDAP server (CVE-2020-9495). Affects all versions before 2.2.5.

threats.name: Arbitrary file write and delete via artifact upload
threats.description: It is possible to write files to the Archiva server at arbitrary locations by using the artifact upload mechanism (CVE-2019-0214). Affects all versions before 2.2.4; 2.2.4 adds additional validations.

threats.name: Arbitrary user password reset
threats.description: CVE-2022-29405: arbitrary user password reset (listed on the security page without expanded description).

threats.name: Remote code execution via vulnerable bundled libraries
threats.description: Remote command execution through the bundled Struts library (CVE-2013-2251, CVE-2010-1870) and through Log4j2 (CVE-2021-44228, where attackers may inject statements into HTTP requests which may be interpreted by the logging library enabling arbitrary code downloads; CVE-2021-45046 applying only to certain non-default configurations; and CVE-2021-45105 infinite recursion, exploitable if users changed the default Archiva log4j2.xml configuration).

controls.name: Upgrade to a release containing the fix
controls.description: Binary patches for individual vulnerabilities are not provided; users have to upgrade to a version where the fix is implemented (for example 2.2.5+ for the LDAP injection, 2.2.4+ for the file write and stored configuration XSS, 2.2.3+ for the REST CSRF issues).

controls.name: CSRF protections (referrer check, origin verification, password prompt)
controls.description: Fixes added a referrer check to the security interceptor, required a password prompt for account changes (2.2.x era, CVE-2010-3449), and added origin verification measures for REST endpoints (2.2.3, CVE-2017-5657).

controls.name: Use TLS between browser and Archiva server
controls.description: Use TLS for the communication between browser and the Archiva server so that it cannot be compromised (listed as mitigation for the stored configuration XSS, CVE-2019-0213).

controls.name: Restrict access to the admin role
controls.description: Restrict the access to the admin role, since only users with the admin role can change the central configuration exploited in CVE-2019-0213.

controls.name: Restrict upload permissions to fewer users
controls.description: Restrict the artifact upload permission to a smaller set of users (listed as mitigation for the arbitrary file write, CVE-2019-0214).

controls.name: Limit filesystem write permissions of the Archiva run user
controls.description: Limit the filesystem write permissions of the user that runs Archiva (listed as mitigation for the arbitrary file write, CVE-2019-0214).
